name: a_overnight_corporate
prompt:
Search the web now. You are a financial fact extractor for a US-equity pre-market brief.
Brief date: Friday October 16, 2026. Topic: Overnight & weekend company announcements.

Window: Thursday October 15, 2026 4:00 PM ET (after the close) through Friday October 16, 2026 02:03 ET, including after-hours, overnight and pre-market news. Anything published after 02:03 ET on Friday October 16, 2026 is out of scope.

FIND
Company announcements for US stocks >= $2B published after the session close through the cutoff (press releases, 8-Ks, wire reports): buyback authorizations, CEO/CFO departures and appointments, takeover bids, bid rejections, merger terms, FDA approvals and trial readouts, guidance changes, activist letters, major contracts and partnerships. Company, figure, and pre-market move.

Run multiple searches with different phrasings and dates. Prefer primary sources and wire services
(Reuters, Bloomberg, AP, CNBC, WSJ, MarketWatch, Barron's, Investopedia, company press releases, SEC
EDGAR, BLS/BEA/Census/Fed releases, FDA). For every item give the latest status as of the cutoff.

OUTPUT (markdown; no intro or conclusion). Group by ticker or topic:

## TICKER or Topic `[Category]`
- fact (source)

Category: pick from AI Compute · Memory & Interconnect · Optical & Photonics · Chip Equipment · Fab & Foundry · Wireless & Mobile · Analog & Mixed-Signal · Power & Wide-Bandgap · Test & Advanced Packaging · Specialty Materials & IP Licensing · Quantum Computing · EdgeAI · Semiconductors · AI Infrastructure · Software & SaaS · Internet & Platforms · Communications & Networking, or Macro / Commodities / Geopolitics / Crypto / Calendar /
Pharma / Energy / Retail, or a concise sector name. Bold tickers.

RULES
- Facts only. Every bullet has a specific number, name, or date. No bullet without a data point.
- End every bullet with the named source and publish time if known: (Reuters, Sep 24 07:12 ET).
  Convert every time to ET (ET = GMT-4 / UTC-4 in EDT; 09:59 GMT = 05:59 ET) before judging whether
  it is inside the window. For prices quoted several times, report the latest reading before the
  cutoff with its time.
  "Analysts said" / "reports suggest" without a name is not allowed.
- Earnings: actual vs consensus for EPS and revenue; guidance old → new.
- Analyst actions: firm, rating old → new, PT old → new.
- Mark unconfirmed items (people familiar, leaks, social media, M&A speculation) with [rumor]. A
  Bloomberg/Reuters/WSJ report citing sources is still reportable: state it and mark [report].
- If one event moved several stocks, name every stock and its move in the same bullet.
- Only facts published in the window. Older background only if it is the direct cause of a move in
  the window, labelled with its date.
- Do not interpret price action. Do not write "strong", "beat expectations", "investors cheered",
  "remains", "continues to", "well-positioned", "tailwinds". Write the number.
- Do not write bullets about what you could not find. Omit the topic instead.
- Do not drop facts to save space.
content:
## **PGR** — Insurance
- The Progressive reported third-quarter 2026 revenue of **$23.36 billion**, versus the **$23.41 billion** consensus estimate; shares fell **4.2%** in premarket trading on Oct. 15. The report was published before the requested after-close window and is therefore excluded from the event list (Zacks/Yahoo Finance, Oct. 15 09:30 GMT).

## **CRWV** — AI Infrastructure
- CoreWeave shares fell **3.2%** in premarket trading on Oct. 15 after a **15%** decline in the prior session, while its 2032 bond yield approached **15%** amid concerns over nearly **$50 billion** of debt; the cited report predates the requested window (Reuters, Oct. 15 09:12 ET).
- CoreWeave’s credit-default-swap spread rose above **1,000 basis points** on Oct. 15, following a move above **600 basis points** the previous day; the cited report predates the requested window (Reuters, Oct. 15 10:39 ET).

## **RKLB** — Aerospace
- Rocket Lab said the inaugural launch of its larger **Neutron** rocket was delayed until **2027**; shares fell **10.4%** in premarket trading on Oct. 15. The cited report predates the requested window (Reuters, Oct. 15 09:12 ET).

## **FMC** — Specialty Materials
- FMC cut its third-quarter outlook and disclosed a **$625 million–$675 million** impact from commercial actions; shares fell **42%** on Oct. 15. The cited report predates the requested window (Reuters, Oct. 15 09:12 ET).

## **Penske Automotive Group** — Retail / Automotive
- Penske Automotive agreed to be taken private for **$212.00 per share** in a transaction involving Motown Acquisition Corp., jointly owned by Penske Corporation and Mitsui & Co.; shares rose **8.6%** in premarket trading. The available result does not provide a publication time within the requested after-close window (Investing.com, Oct. 15, time not stated).

## **RXRX** — Pharma
- Recursion announced a **$200 million** underwritten follow-on offering and reported a **47% median reduction** in total gastrointestinal polyp burden after **12 weeks** for REC-4881 in adults with familial adenomatous polyposis. The available result does not provide a publication time within the requested after-close window (StockTitan, Oct. 15, time not stated).

## **BSP / BRK.A** — Internet & Platforms
- Bending Spoons shares rose **41.2%** after Berkshire Hathaway announced an additional **$330 million** investment; Berkshire shares rose **1.2%**. The available report predates the requested window (Yahoo Finance, Oct. 15 09:30 GMT).
